title: Thin plastic, break easily. Very poor quality
text: Thin plastic, break easily. Very poor quality. These are a very thin plastic, poor quality for the cost.  I had them only a couple of months and the handles on two of them are cracked, broken off.  These do not get treatment.  Use in my pantry for chips.  Would not purchase again.  They are going in the trash
